A. The Client is engaged in the business of providing integrated facilities management services to commercial and residential complexes across India.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

**1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION**

1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following terms shall have the meanings ascribed to them below:

(a) **"Agreement"** shall mean this Service Agreement, including all Schedules, Annexures, and amendments thereto, as may be executed by the Parties from time to time.

(b) **"Applicable Law"** shall mean all statutes, enactments, acts of legislature, ordinances, rules, bye-laws, regulations, notifications, guidelines, policies, directions, directives, and orders of any governmental, statutory, or regulatory authority, including but not limited to the laws of India, as may be in force from time to time.

The headquarters_city of GreenTech Facilities Pvt. Ltd. is Kolkata. Record status: current.

(c) **"Business Day"** shall mean a day (other than a Sunday) on which banks in Kolkata, West Bengal, are open for general business.

(d) **"Change of Control"** shall mean, with respect to a Party, (i) the acquisition by any person or group of persons acting in concert, directly or indirectly, of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting share capital of such Party, or (ii) any change in the power, directly or indirectly, to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of such Party, whether through the ownership of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise.

(e) **"Client"** shall have the meaning ascribed to it in the preamble above.

(f) **"Confidential Information"** shall mean all information, data, drawings, specifications, documents, reports, know-how, trade secrets, and other materials, whether in oral, written, electronic, or any other form, disclosed by one Party to the other Party in connection with this Agreement, including but not limited to the terms of this Agreement, the pricing information, the technical data, the operational data, the Site-specific information, and any other information marked as confidential or which a reasonable person would understand to be confidential.

(g) **"Force Majeure"** shall mean any event or circumstance not within the reasonable control of the affected Party, including but not limited to war, riot, civil commotion, strike, lockout, fire, flood, earthquake, cyclone, lightning, epidemic, pandemic, act of God, or any other similar event, which prevents or delays the performance of any obligation under this Agreement.

(h) **"Month"** shall mean a calendar month.

(i) **"Service Provider"** shall have the meaning ascribed to it in the preamble above.

(j) **"Services"** shall mean the building energy management, HVAC optimization, chiller plant operation, and related services to be provided by the Service Provider to the Client at the Sites, as more particularly described in **Schedule A** to this Agreement.
**2. SITE AND PREMISES**

**2.1 Site Description**

The Services shall be performed at the site described below (each such site, a "Site", and collectively, the "Sites"):

**Kolkata Central Office Park ("KCOP")**
Survey Plot No. 44/1, Block – GN, Sector V, Salt Lake City
Kolkata – 700091, West Bengal, India

The Site comprises a commercial office complex developed, owned, and operated by the Client. The Site is situated on a plot of land admeasuring approximately 4.2 acres, more fully described in the title documents and site plan attached hereto as **Schedule B**.

**2.2 Building Details**

The Site consists of the following buildings and structures, all of which form part of the premises covered under this Agreement:

(a) **Tower A** – a ground-plus-twelve (G+12) storey commercial office building, used primarily for corporate offices and administrative functions;

(b) **Tower B** – a ground-plus-ten (G+10) storey commercial office building, used primarily for co-working spaces and client meeting areas;

(c) **Tower C** – a ground-plus-eight (G+8) storey commercial office building, currently partially occupied, with the remaining floors under fit-out; and

(d) **Ancillary Structures** – including a two-level basement car park, a service block housing the central plant room and electrical substations, a security control room at the main entrance, and a cafeteria block.

The total floor area of the Site, measured on a plinth-to-plinth basis across all floors of all buildings and ancillary structures, is approximately **2,50,000 (Two Lakh Fifty Thousand) square feet** (the "Total Floor Area"). Kolkata Central Office Park's total_floor_area_sqft is 250000 sqft. Record status: current. The Total Floor Area is current as of the date of this Agreement and shall be used as the basis for calculating certain charges, service levels, and performance benchmarks set out in this Agreement and its Schedules.

**2.3 Site Access and Working Hours**

The Service Provider shall have access to the Site, and to the plant rooms, equipment rooms, and other areas required for the performance of the Services, during the following hours:

(a) **Normal Working Hours**: 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday, excluding public holidays observed by the Client.

(b) **Extended Access**: Outside Normal Working Hours and on Sundays and public holidays, access shall be available on prior notice of at least four (4) hours, subject to the security procedures of the Site. The Service Provider shall ensure that its personnel carry valid identity cards and are registered with the Site security office.

(c) **Emergency Access**: In the event of an emergency affecting the operation of the building systems, the Service Provider's designated emergency personnel shall have round-the-clock access to the Site, provided that the Site security office is notified immediately upon arrival.

**2.4 Site Facilities Provided by the Client**

The Client shall provide, at no cost to the Service Provider, the following facilities for the performance of the Services:

(a) a designated area for the Service Provider's site office, including table, chairs, and a telephone connection;

(b) access to a shared restroom and drinking water facility;

(c) a dedicated power supply point for the Service Provider's tools and testing equipment;

(d) a secure storage area for the Service Provider's tools, spare parts, and consumables; and
**3. SCOPE OF SERVICES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**3.1 Engagement of Service Provider**

The Client engages the Service Provider, and the Service Provider accepts engagement, to provide the Building Management System (BMS) services described in this Clause 3 and in Schedule B (the "Services") at Kolkata Central Office Park (the "Site"). The Service Provider shall perform the Services as an independent contractor and not as an agent, partner, or employee of the Client. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to create a joint venture, partnership, or employer-employee relationship between the parties.

**3.2 BMS Vendor**

The parties acknowledge that the BMS installed at the Site has been supplied, commissioned, and is currently maintained by **Innova Building Systems** (the "BMS Vendor"). GreenTech Facilities Pvt. Ltd.'s bms_vendor is Innova Building Systems. Record status: current. The BMS Vendor's status as the current vendor for the Site's BMS is recorded in the Client's vendor register and has not been superseded as of the Effective Date. The Service Provider shall coordinate with the BMS Vendor as required for the proper delivery of the Services, including but not limited to:

(a) providing the BMS Vendor with reasonable access to the Site during Normal Working Hours for the purpose of software updates, firmware patches, and system diagnostics;

(b) informing the BMS Vendor promptly of any recurring alarms, faults, or performance anomalies that the Service Provider reasonably believes may be attributable to the BMS hardware or software;

(c) maintaining a log of all interactions with the BMS Vendor, including the date, time, nature of the request, and resolution status; and

(d) escalating to the BMS Vendor, through the Client's designated representative, any matter that the Service Provider cannot resolve using its own resources within the response times set out in Schedule C.

**3.3 Monitoring Services**

The Service Provider shall provide remote and on-site monitoring of the BMS covering the following systems and equipment at the Site:

(a) HVAC plant, including chillers, pumps, cooling towers, AHUs, FCUs, and VAV boxes;

(b) electrical distribution, including LT panels, DG sets, UPS systems, and energy meters;

(c) plumbing and water supply, including pumps, tanks, and leak detection;

(d) fire alarm and fire suppression systems, limited to supervisory monitoring and not including maintenance of such systems, which is covered under a separate contract; and

(e) lifts and escalators, limited to status monitoring through the BMS interface.

The Service Provider shall operate a central monitoring station during Normal Working Hours, and shall respond to alarms and alerts in accordance with the priority levels and response times set out in Schedule C. The Service Provider shall maintain a continuous log of all alarms received, actions taken, and the time of resolution. Where an alarm cannot be resolved remotely or on-site within the applicable response time, the Service Provider shall notify the Client's designated representative by telephone and by email within thirty (30) minutes of the expiry of the applicable response time.

**3.4 Preventive Maintenance Services**

The Service Provider shall carry out preventive maintenance of the BMS and connected field devices in accordance with the maintenance schedule set out in Schedule D. The maintenance schedule shall include, at a minimum:
**4. INVOICING AND PAYMENT TERMS**

**4.1 Invoicing Schedule**

The Service Provider shall submit invoices to the Client on a monthly basis, within five (5) Business Days following the end of each calendar month for which services have been rendered. Each invoice shall set out, in reasonable detail, the services performed during the applicable month, the applicable fees calculated in accordance with Schedule A, and any reimbursable expenses incurred in accordance with Clause 4.4.

**4.2 Payment Terms**

The Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the date of receipt of such invoice (the "Due Date"). Payment shall be made by electronic funds transfer to the bank account designated by the Service Provider in writing. For the avoidance of doubt, time shall be of the essence with respect to the Client's payment obligations under this Agreement.

In the event the Client disputes any portion of an invoice, the Client shall notify the Service Provider in writing within fifteen (15) days of receipt of the invoice, specifying the disputed amount and the reasons for the dispute in reasonable detail. The parties shall use good faith efforts to resolve any such dispute within fifteen (15) days of the Service Provider's receipt of the notice. The undisputed portion of the invoice shall be paid by the Due Date, and the disputed portion shall be paid within fifteen (15) days of resolution of the dispute. Failure by the Client to notify the Service Provider of a dispute within the fifteen (15) day period shall constitute acceptance of the invoice in full.

**4.3 Late Payment**

If the Client fails to pay any amount due under this Agreement on or before the Due Date, the Service Provider shall be entitled to charge, and the Client shall pay, interest on the overdue amount at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month, compounded monthly, from the Due Date until the date of actual payment. The Service Provider shall also be entitled to suspend provision of the Services, in whole or in part, upon not less than seven (7) days' prior written notice to the Client, if any undisputed amount remains unpaid for more than thirty (30) days beyond the Due Date. Suspension of Services shall not relieve the Client of its payment obligations, and the Service Provider shall resume provision of the Services within five (5) Business Days of receipt of all outstanding amounts.

**4.4 Reimbursable Expenses**

The Client shall reimburse the Service Provider for all reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the Service Provider in the performance of the Services, including but not limited to travel, lodging, and per diem costs incurred in connection with on-site visits outside the Site's local metropolitan area, and the cost of spare parts and consumables procured with the Client's prior written approval. The Service Provider shall provide receipts or other supporting documentation for all reimbursable expenses. No reimbursable expense shall exceed INR 50,000 without the Client's prior written approval.

**4.5 Taxes**

All fees and charges set out in this Agreement are exclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, and levies, including but not limited to Goods and Services Tax (GST). The Client shall pay all such taxes, duties, and levies in addition to the fees and charges, at the rates applicable from time to time. The Service Provider shall issue tax invoices as required under applicable law. The Client shall be responsible for any taxes imposed on the Client's income or on the payments made by the Client under this Agreement, and the Service Provider shall be responsible for taxes imposed on its own income.
**5. AMENDMENTS AND VARIATIONS**

**5.1 General**
This Agreement may be amended, varied, or modified only by a written instrument duly executed by the authorised representatives of both Parties. No oral amendment, waiver, or modification shall be binding on either Party, and any attempted oral amendment shall be void ab initio. Each amendment shall be numbered sequentially and shall state the date of its execution and the clause(s) of this Agreement to which it relates.

**5.2 Amendment Procedure**
Either Party may propose an amendment by delivering a written notice to the other Party, setting out the proposed text and the commercial or operational rationale therefor. The receiving Party shall respond to any such proposal within fifteen (15) Business Days of receipt. If the Parties agree on the terms of the proposed amendment, the authorised representatives shall execute the amendment instrument in accordance with Clause 5.1. If the Parties do not agree, the matter shall be referred to the senior management of each Party for further discussion, and thereafter, if unresolved, shall be dealt with in accordance with Clause 8 (Dispute Resolution).

**5.3 Effect of Amendment**
Upon execution, each amendment shall form an integral part of this Agreement and shall prevail over any conflicting provision of the original Agreement to the extent of the inconsistency. No amendment shall operate as a waiver of any right accrued prior to the effective date of such amendment, unless expressly stated in the amendment instrument. For the avoidance of doubt, the execution of a subsequent amendment shall not affect the validity of any prior amendment unless expressly stated.

**5.4 Record of Amendments**
The Service Provider shall maintain a consolidated register of all amendments to this Agreement, indicating the amendment number, date of execution, and the principal subject matter of each amendment. A copy of the register shall be provided to the Client upon reasonable request. The current consolidated version of this Agreement, incorporating all executed amendments, shall be held by the Service Provider and made available for inspection by the Client at the Service Provider's registered office during normal business hours.

**6. TERM AND TERMINATION**

**6.1 Term**
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial term of three (3) years (the "Initial Term"), unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Clause 6. Upon expiry of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall be automatically renewed for successive periods of one (1) year each (each a "Renewal Term"), unless either Party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiry of the then-current term.

**6.2 Termination for Convenience**
The Client may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for any reason or no reason, by giving the Service Provider not less than one hundred twenty (120) days' prior written notice. The Service Provider may terminate this Agreement for convenience only upon the occurrence of an event specified in Clause 6.4 or 6.5.

**6.4 Termination for Cause by the Service Provider**
The Service Provider may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by written notice to the Client if:
(a) the Client fails to pay any undisputed amount due under this Agreement within thirty (30) days after the Due Date, and such failure continues for a further fifteen (15) days after written notice of such failure is given to the Client;
(b) the Client commits a material breach of any provision of this Agreement and, where such breach is capable of remedy, fails to remedy the same within thirty (30) days of receipt of written notice from the Service Provider; or
(c) the Client becomes insolvent, is adjudicated bankrupt, or passes a resolution for winding up.

interface schedule.
